title: Saudi-Led Coalition Says Air Defences Destroyed Four Houthi Drones and Intercepted Three Missiles
detail: The Saudi-led coalition said its air defences destroyed four Houthi drones targeting southern Saudi Arabia and intercepted three Houthi missiles launched towards the Eastern Region. The account comes from coalition statements relayed by Middle East Eye's live blog and is not independently verified; no damage or casualties were reported.

media.caption: Air defences destroy four Houthi drones targeting Saudi Arabia's south
